verdict.rationale: Shopify documents and ships an official UCP CLI (`@shopify/ucp-cli`) with structured commands for catalog search, cart building, checkout, and order tracking, backed by a quickstart guide and runtime probes confirming live functionality (cart creation, catalog search) against real endpoints. missing for 10: independent third-party (non-Shopify) hands-on reviews of the CLI itself and broader adoption evidence beyond Shopify's own docs/probes.
